question: Please help me identify the top 3 bowlers who, in the overs where the maximum runs were conceded in each match, gave up the highest number of runs in a single over across all matches. For each of these bowlers, provide the match in which they conceded these maximum runs. Only consider overs that had the most runs conceded within their respective matches, and among these, determine which bowlers conceded the most runs in a single over overall.
sql:
WITH over_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        bs.match_id,
        bs.over_id,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) as runs_from_batsman,
        COALESCE(SUM(er.extra_runs), 0) as runs_from_extra,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) + COALESCE(SUM(er.extra_runs), 0) as total_runs
    FROM batsman_scored bs
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON bs.match_id = er.match_id AND bs.over_id = er.over_id AND bs.ball_id = er.ball_id AND bs.innings_no = er.innings_no
    GROUP BY bs.match_id, bs.over_id
),
max_runs_per_match AS (
    SELECT match_id, MAX(total_runs) as max_runs
    FROM over_runs
    GROUP BY match_id
),
max_run_overs AS (
    SELECT orm.match_id, orm.over_id, orm.total_runs
    FROM over_runs orm
    JOIN max_runs_per_match mrm ON orm.match_id = mrm.match_id AND orm.total_runs = mrm.max_runs
),
ball_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.match_id,
        bb.over_id,
        bb.ball_id,
        bb.bowler,
        bs.runs_scored,
        COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0) as extra_runs,
        bs.runs_scored + COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0) as runs_on_ball
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON bb.match_id = er.match_id AND bb.over_id = er.over_id AND bb.ball_id = er.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = er.innings_no
),
bowler_over_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        mro.match_id,
        mro.over_id,
        br.bowler,
        SUM(br.runs_on_ball) as runs_conceded_by_bowler
    FROM max_run_overs mro
    JOIN ball_runs br ON mro.match_id = br.match_id AND mro.over_id = br.over_id
    GROUP BY mro.match_id, mro.over_id, br.bowler
),
top_bowlers AS (
    SELECT bowler, runs_conceded_by_bowler, match_id
    FROM bowler_over_runs
    ORDER BY runs_conceded_by_bowler DESC, match_id
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT tb.bowler, tb.runs_conceded_by_bowler, tb.match_id, p.player_name, m.team_1, m.team_2, m.match_date
FROM top_bowlers tb
JOIN player p ON tb.bowler = p.player_id
JOIN match m ON tb.match_id = m.match_id
ORDER BY tb.runs_conceded_by_bowler DESC
